cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've closed the flight page like you. That's our flight chosen. I still haven't bought the anniversary tickets; can you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I closed a duplicate tab. We haven't chosen a flight. I thought you just needed help choosing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, one page at a time. I let you think that. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the laptop shut. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can you still sit beside me while I find the words?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies tab closure as flight selected; A3 covers duplicate correction while admitting concealed relief; A5 escalates to relationship doubt after B4 stays.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 choosing-help assumption is exposed by A3 relief; B4 trip-or-us makes A5 deeper truth and presence request.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers task help and B4 shifts to attentive support.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 staying and direct question to risk more honesty.

specificity.evidence: A1 choice versus purchase now distinct; B2 explicitly denies selection.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 find-the-words request advances vulnerability without coaching.
